name: aura-visualizer
description: Visualize your codebase in 3D directly in VSCode — interactive dependency graph with force-directed layout

commands.title: Aura: Focus Current File in Graph

auraVisualizer.maxFiles.description: Maximum number of files to analyze

auraVisualizer.autoRefresh.description: Automatically refresh visualization when files are saved

steps.title: Open the 3D Visualizer
steps.description:
Press ``Ctrl+Shift+A`` (or ``Cmd+Shift+A`` on Mac) to open the interactive 3D graph of your codebase.

[Open Visualizer](command:auraVisualizer.open)

steps.title: Explore the Graph
steps.description:
**Click** a node to see file details. **Double-click** to open the file in the editor. **Right-click** to pin focus on a file and its neighbors.

Use the mouse wheel to zoom and drag to rotate.

steps.title: Use Heatmaps
steps.description:
Click the heatmap buttons in the toolbar to color nodes by **Complexity**, **Fan-in**, **Fan-out**, **Lines of Code**, or **Last Modified**.

Spot hotspots at a glance!

steps.title: Find Dependency Paths
steps.description:
Click the **Path** button in the toolbar, then click two nodes to find the shortest dependency path between them.

Great for understanding how files are connected.

steps.title: Detect Dead Code & Cycles
steps.description:
Press **X** to highlight unused exports (dead code). Press **C** to reveal circular dependencies. Press **O** to find orphan files.

Clean up your codebase!

steps.title: Travel Through Git History
steps.description:
Use the **timeline bar** at the bottom to navigate your project's commit history. Changed files light up in yellow at each step.

Watch your architecture evolve!

steps.title: AI Integration (MCP Server)
steps.description:
Aura includes a built-in **MCP server** with 8 tools for AI assistants. Query dependencies, find dead code, search symbols — all programmatically.

Works with GitHub Copilot and other MCP clients.

steps.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
steps.description:
Use single-key shortcuts: **F** recenter, **H** heatmaps, **D** DAG, **X** dead code, **C** cycles, **1-5** depth, **←→** timeline.

All features are one key away!
